releases.name: Seafarer: The Ship Sim
releases.summary: For anybody from age 6 to99.Just position and rotate the pieces so that all animals have the proper front and back.it seems easy at first to position the 9 pieces correctly, but it is actually really tricky and the end the darn last piece doesn't match.If you like, or if after hours and days you still haven't solved it yet, you can switch to level 1.  This is much simpler because the pieces are already rotated correctly and you "only" have to find their right spot.Aaron's darn puzzle game is a learning game that trains and encourages focus and spatial intellect.++++ Features:Two levels of difficulty- Level 1 = easy- Level 2 = difficult, the pieces have to also be rotated correctlyYou can set the level of the backgroundmusik and sounds or turn them of separatly.If you have suggestions or ideas we are more than happy to learn about them.  Just use the build in message-feature from the Infoscreen.

releases.name: Into the Radius 2
releases.summary: Into the Radius 2 is an immersive VR survival shooter, set in a realm of surreal landscapes and deadly entities known as Pechorsk Anomaly. Arm yourself with realistic weapons and venture deeper into the mysteries that lie within, either solo or as part of a team.

releases.name: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow
releases.summary: Tokyo has fallen. In the wake of the 'Collapse,' time is your ultimate weapon. Unleash real-time skills, predict enemy moves, and deliver devastating counters in this high-stakes Tactical Timeline RPG.

releases.name: CONTROL Resonant
releases.summary: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and our survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat. After years in confinement at the hands of the Federal Bureau of Control (FBC), Dylan Faden emerges into a warped Manhattan at the peak of a paranatural crisis. Charged with combating a mysterious cosmic entity as it alters fundamental aspects of our reality, Dylan must harness his new-found powers to take the fight to the myriad threats overwhelming Manhattan. On the path to unlocking the full potential of his paranatural abilities Dylan will also seek out his sister, FBC Director Jesse Faden, as he bids to comprehend and contain the dangers that have spilled beyond the confines of the Oldest House to tear our world apart. [Remedy]

releases.name: Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection
releases.summary:
35 years ago, this station initiated blackout protocols, burying the first era of Intex’s xeno operations.

Your objective - Infiltrate the station, get power and systems back online, uncover the last, complete archive of original redacted documents, first-person combat firefights and classified secrets.

Celebrate 35 years of isometric sci-fi horror-action with the definitive Alien Breed Collection. Experience the complete library of games, extras and more from the franchise’s first era, all optimised in their original formats for modern devices.

Step behind the airlocks to explore an expansive archive of the series' history through an in-universe interactive experience, hiding more than a few secrets. The Vault offers a deep dive into the concept art and original retail launches, while The Timeline features exclusive developer interviews and retrospective videos from the original team.

releases.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
releases.summary: Simon Ordell is called back to the island of St. Amelia to ‘put things right’, encountering a town lying quiet beneath a heavy fog, seemingly abandoned but not at rest. Venturing deeper, and driven to understand his connection to the place and its inhabitants, Simon begins to discover fragments of a past rising to the surface. Preserving the core identity of psychological horror that the series is renowned for, SILENT HILL: Townfall presents an all-new, self-contained story, suitable for those both new to the series, and those who have ventured into the fog before. Fog-soaked streets, abandoned communities, and forgotten corners tell their story through atmosphere and history. Reality and delusion subtly intertwine to lure players into the depths of the grounded, tangible world of St. Amelia.  SILENT HILL: Townfall exudes the beautiful and foggy streets of Scotland, offering a new setting to tell a unique and haunting story. More than just a horror game, this is a tale of introspection, loss, and consequence. Fear grows from small details, quiet moments, and the long shadow of Simon's past.  Swing and block with melee weapons in frenetic melee combat, or keep your distance and use firearms to survive. Choose how to engage in each encounter, using both the tools at your disposal and the environment around you. Beyond fighting or fleeing, carefully sneak past danger through stealth, tracking enemy positions from cover or luring them away with distractions. [Konami]

releases.name: Kalanoro
releases.summary:
A world inspired by Madagascar’s folklore. Once a paradise, it now suffers under the witch Raneny’s ruthless rule. Having grown tired of exploiting its people, she decided to host a huge concert with the island’s most famous band. You’re sent on a mission to fight back by rallying legendary musicians to your cause! 

Dash through diverse biomes across Lemuria, save and befriend funky locals to form your crew, and jump over industrial platforming traps to become Lemuria’s number one band and finally face Raneny! 

Defeat Raneny’s minions in fast-paced combat, using hair-based powers and improvised weapons (slippers included) to fight epic and groovy boss battles and free the island! 

Assemble a band of eccentric lemur artists, manage your tour bus through mini-games, and build your band’s popularity among locals to perform on bigger stages.

releases.name: Heroes of Magic & Cards
releases.summary: No jogo Ping Bola a finalidade é quebrar os blocos, tomando cuidado para não reduzir o tamanho da base, pois com isso o risco de perda aumenta. Tenha calma e jogue à vontade, tente quebrar o maior número de blocos para aumentar sua pontuação.

releases.name: SiN: Reloaded
releases.summary:
From Nightdive Studios, SiN: Reloaded is a completely remastered experience of the 1998 shooter from Ritual Entertainment. This diamond-in-the-rough, story-driven FPS features memorable characters, horrific enemies, and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits.

Enter a near-future dystopian world as security consultant Colonel John R. Blade as you take on the seductively evil Doctor Elexis Sinclaire. When Elexis, the CEO of SinTEK Industries, begins injecting the streets with a DNA-altering drug, it's time to reassess the laws of morality. 

As Blade, you've made a religion out of fighting crime. Now you're going to make Elexis pay for her sins by taking on her unholy army of genetically-engineered mutants.

releases.name: Garfield: Escape from Monday
releases.summary:
Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

When you’re a lazy cat spending most of his time sleeping, having a nightmare can happen. But a nightmare full of vegetables and sugar-free candies, no way!

After Jon fed him spinach lasagnas inspired by Chef Monday’s recipe, Garfield falls into a deep sleep...

To wake up and reactivate his taste buds, the laziest cat in the world will have to explore worlds filled with enemies and eat a gigantic deal of lasagnas!

Fortunately Garfield can rely on Jon and his friends Odie, Arlene and Pookie. But also on his turkey, surfer and cowboy suits that will give him amazing skills!

- Move like a cat
Jump, climb the walls, curl up into a ball… you will always land on your feet!

- Embody Garfield in every form
Go airborne dressed as a turkey, slide on the water like a surfer and swing with your cowboy lasso!

- All the Garfield cast is here
Jon will be here to help you in your quest, along with Odie and Pookie. But beware Garfield's archenemies, Nermal and Squeak!

- Explore lively worlds
3 worlds and dozens of levels filled with enemies to fight and lasagnas to devour to regain the taste.

- The more you eat, the more rooms you edit!
Gather tons of delicious collectibles to keep your morale and help refurbish Jon's house with all kinds of surprising items.

releases.name: Farming Camp
releases.summary:
Farming Camp is a cozy, single-player farm management game that follows the journey of an ambitious teenager competing to become the best farmer in the camp. Manage your farm alongside your companions, complete chores for points, and deal with the dynamics of a colorful cast in their teenage years.

Step into the boots of young Alessandra, before she became the renowned Evertree Farmer. Experience her life at the Evertree Farming Camp where it all began. Learn the ropes and face the fun and chaos of camp life.

You're not alone on the farm. You’ll have the company of two budding young farmers, each with their own vibe. Assign chores, solve problems, and build friendships as you figure out how to run the farm together.

releases.name: My Hidden Things
releases.summary: An application (intermediary level) with which you can play 25 games prepared and commented by Dominique Pilon to  and revise the principal bridge techniques : indirect finesse, trumping from the short hand, setting a suit, the order of manoeuvring and throw-in. Advanced ( level 1 on a scale of 0 to 4)

releases.name: Xevious 3D/G
releases.summary: One day,when Jack came round,he found himself being trapped in an appalling old house. According to the clues left in the room,he found out that it seems that there's a mysterious man behind all this. This wicked mystery man arranged many traps in each room only for the purpose to tease his prey.Would Jack be able to get out sucessfully and defeat all the evil,it all depends on your memory and wisdom.===============================The basic control:control characters walking by using virtual joystick, touch on the blue box to switch dialogue.================================If you want to experience tense feeling on the creaking floor, or in a perplexing maze,then you might as well get a try..

releases.name: The Trolley Solution
releases.summary: Help!! Your mission is to rescue adorable penguins that have fallen through the ice! They keep getting trapped inside an ice cavern with no way to escape. Use your awesome brain power to solve the word puzzles by throwing snowballs at the icicles attached to the cavern ceiling.    Pull the snowball letter back with your finger, aim it at the icicles, and release!  With each correct letter you’ll see the snowball hit the icicles causing them to fall and break through the ice below. (Yeah!) Solve the word and all the ice blocks will break!! Your penguin can now reach the water and swim out to safety. The fewer tries you take to complete the word, the more points you earn!! Each round you play helps rescue penguins - so keep playing to build up your score and be a total hero!  Visit the penguin village to see all the silly penguins you’ve rescued! Tap on them to see their individual personalities come to life, move them around and position them where you’d like to within the village. You can use the pinch and zoom motion to resize the penguins and make them larger or smaller. Don’t forget to stop by the rescue center igloo and check the message photo board to see which penguins you have rescued and what ones are still missing and need your help! Challenge yourself to beat your top score! And hurry - RESCUE THOSE PENGUINS!!! •Select from multiple categories or just choose “random” for an even more challenging game! •Records High Score at the end of your game •Amazing high-definition graphics•Rescue and collect all the penguins! The more you play the more chances you have to save all of them.•Classic word puzzle game in the style of “hangman” or “wheel of fortune.”•Visit the rescue center, located inside the igloo in the Penguin Village, to see a photo board of all the penguins that need your help!•Move, tap, organize, and watch your penguins animate inside the Penguin Village. Use the pinch/zoom motion to resize them!!•Word puzzles get progressively harder as you answer more and more correctly. Challenge yourself to see how many you can answer consecutively!

releases.name: Karate Champ
releases.summary:
????? The original arcade fighter from Data East comes to the iPhone complete with **MULTI-PLAYER**. Karate Champ is the very first fighting game and spawned a thousand imitators. One of IGN's Top10 Most Influential Games of all time, and to many the game that embodies what a fighter should be.

#1 Game (Arcade) on iTunes in Japan, #5 & 6 in Australia, New Zealand.

As featured on iTunes, Gizmodo, Touch Arcade, and Pocket Gamer, Karate champ is more than a blast from the past and a must-have for your fighting game / retro collection, Karate Champ is unique for it's use of TWO STICKS NO BUTTONS and VERTICAL screen, and available in it's launch week for 30% off!

This not only makes it unique among the fighting game fraternity but perfectly suited to the iPhone from a control perspective, and one of the most affordable 2 player experiences on iTunes.

Features include:

?- Dual Arcade Stick Controls (no D-Pad or buttons).
?- Vertical orientation (no thumbs covering the action :)
?- Virtual arcade cabinet surround and facia
?- 1 Player vs CPU over 12 environments
?- 2 PLAYERS via Bluetooth and WIFI !!
?- all the bonus rounds (including the rampaging bull :)
?- all the classic 80's sounds
?- Various New User Settings
       Super large Character Option
       Customise the arcade unit facia
       Old school scanlines on/off
?- and much much more.

This is no random button masher, it's about skillfully executing perfectly timed karate moves against ever more challenging opponents in your quest to become the one true Karate Champ!

Rebuilt from the ground up for the iPhone and iPod Touch from the team that bought you the highly acclaimed 'Cobra Command' and upcoming 'Frogman', Karate Champ is a beloved retro classic without equal.


Support Notes:

i) 2 Player Mode requires access to wifi OR 2 devices with compatible bluetooth (1st generation iPhone and 1st gen. iPod Touch do not support peer to peer play over bluetooth , just wifi).

ii) Karate Champ provides a lag free experience but to ensure best results use either Wifi OR Bluetooth but don't leave both on as it can cause network confusion in devices. 

iii) A minimum of OS 2.2 required for 1 player game, OS3.1 or greater to enjoy 2 player mode (as that's when peer to peer was introduced to the device).

iv) Karate Champ has been designed for iPhone and iPod Touch play but also looks and plays GREAT on the iPad with 2x scaling and of course multiplayer via wifi/bluetooth. :)

releases.name: I Hear Them
releases.summary: A new picture puzzle guessing game from the creators of Hatchi (Touch Arcade best of 2012). So simple but so much fun. Guess the word from the four pictures.Play multiple modes includingClassic ModeIn classic mode your goal is to guess the words to get as high a level as possible.Snappy ModeGuess as many words seconds as you can in 99 seconds. Chain correct answers for extra points.Survival ModeYour goal is to guess as many words as possible. You have 10 seconds to guess each word. Guess quickly!Optimised for the iPhone 5 tall screen.

releases.name: PUPU's Adventure Park
releases.summary: Collect Extra Lives and PrizesJump Through Unique and Colorful Worlds Avoid Deadly Obstacles and FallsWicked Fun Aim n' Bounce actionAngry Enemies to Jump and AvoidSuper Smooth Fun Physics Based Endless GameplayGame Center supportEasy Tap Controlsand much more…

releases.name: Sandwalkers
releases.summary: Did you find the original Four Word Link Game a little easy, want something more challenging, then this 'Genius Edition' is the game for you?! With 150 levels of fiendishly tricky puzzles, this will have you scratching your head again and again! This great new word game will challenge your brain as you work out which one word answer links all four clue words, each correct answer is hidden within the 12 scrambled letters.Some answers are straightforward and some are more fiendish, but don't worry, if you get stuck you can choose to see a helpful hint letter or remove some of the scrambled letters to get you closer to revealing the right answer! This game will have you picking it up over and over again as you try to crack the code which link the words!

releases.name: VORON: Raven's Story
releases.summary: Hot Hand: 3 Card Poker - Casino style poker with bonus payouts!Basic Rules:Each hand requires a bet on either ante, pair+ or both. Once a bet is in play, 3 cards will be dealt to you, and if an ante bet is placed, 3 cards face down to the dealer. You will then have the opportunity to raise or fold your hand. A raise will double your original ante bet. A fold will end the hand in play.After a raise is made, the dealer cards will flip over. The dealer must have a queen high or better to qualify. If the dealer’s hand qualifies, your hands will be compared. The highest hand wins ante bet x 2 x any applicable multiplier. High card rules apply. If the dealer’s hand is disqualified, you win ante bet x 1.5 x any applicable multiplier.Ante bonuses are awarded on an ante bet based on the strength of your hand and regardless of the dealer’s hand. For example, if the dealer’s hand is disqualified or his hand is higher than yours, you will still be awarded an ante bonus, if applicable. Ante bonuses are awarded on hands from a straight and higher.Pair+ is awarded on a pair+ bet based on the strength of your hand and regardless of the dealer’s hand. This is paid independently from an ante bet and can be played on a hand in conjunction with an ante bet or by itself. A pair+ payout is awarded on hands from a pair and higher.Game Features: Daily chip & multiplier rewards! Cards are randomly awarded a multiplier value and are awarded in conjunction with any winning bet. Ante bonuses & pair+ payouts are awarded up to a royal flush in spades, and pay independently from the dealer’s hand.Changeable credit values ranging from 1¢, 2¢, 5¢, 10¢. Purchase the 6 items in the gift shop using your winnings to unlock higher credit values (up to $5), add bonus cards to the game deck, increase the multiplier frequency and even unlock a larger multiplier! Work your way up to piles of chips to become to ultimate card shark! Swipe up for a max bet, or raise, if you’re feeling lucky. Swipe down to deal the initial hand, or fold after cards are dealt. Swipe right or left to toggle the credit values. Deal your way to earning all 60 achievements. Statistics feature keeps track of your gameplay. Some statistics include: win/loss ratio, total wins, total losses, biggest win on either credit value, bonus games played, and MORE! Any bonus card dealt triggers the bonus game.Bonus Game: Am I being hustled?! 15 cards spread across the table. Tap a card to reveal its value. Continue to rack up credits until you reveal a ‘Collect’ symbol. Features:* 1 Card Triggers Bonus Game* Statistics Feature* 60 Achievements Feature* 6 Gift Shop Items* 1¢, 2¢, 5¢, 10¢ Credit Values* Unlock Higher Credit Values (up to $5)

releases.name: BIRDCAGE
releases.summary: Buzz the Angry Bee is flying through the meadow and needs you to help him out!Angry Bee Battle is a FREE, simple and addicting game that's fun for all ages. Help Buzz & Bea collect coins and avoid the enemies that are trying to get them!How long can you fly through the meadow? Think you got what it takes to rack up those coins? The game will start moving faster and faster, so watch out for those birds and hornets!Collect enough coins and you can unlock additional characters for even more fun!*** FEATURES **** Incredible endless gameplay means a new game every time* Collect coins to unlock more characters* Simple game controls good for both kids and adults* Amazing graphics* Game Center enabled* Universal app supports iPhone / iPad / iPod TouchDownload Angry Bee Battle right now while it's 100% FREE!
